description: Server-side custom events posted to heapanalytics.com/api/track. The Heap.js 5 config loader is vendor/heap. Classic heap-{id}.js is vendor/heap-classic.

params.name: app_id
params.description: It is the Heap environment ID. Heap documents it as required on every track call.
params.fix_hint: Set `app_id` to the environment ID from Heap Projects.

params.name: event
params.description: It is the server-side event name. Heap documents it as required, limited to 1024 characters.
params.fix_hint: Set `event` to the custom event name, such as `Purchase Completed`, in at most 1024 characters.

params.name: identity
params.description: It identifies the user. Heap documents a case-sensitive string of at most 255 characters, and requires either `identity` or `user_id`, not both.
params.fix_hint: Send the same identity you use in Heap Identify, at most 255 characters.

params.name: user_id
params.description: It is Heap's anonymous user id. Heap documents the string form of a number from 0 through 2^53-1.
params.fix_hint: Send the numeric `user_id` from the Heap SDK, digits only.

params.name: timestamp
params.description: Heap documents `timestamp` as an ISO 8601 datetime. When omitted, Heap stamps the arrival time.
params.fix_hint: Send an ISO 8601 timestamp, such as `2026-07-26T06:00:00Z`.

params.name: idempotency_key
params.description: Heap uses it to drop duplicate track calls.

params.name: properties.user_id
params.description: Heap reserves `user_id` as a top-level field. Reusing it inside `properties` produces unexpected behavior.
params.fix_hint: Rename the property. Send `user_id` at the top level when you have the SDK id.

params.name: properties.session_id
params.description: Heap reserves `session_id` as a top-level field. Reusing it inside `properties` produces unexpected behavior.
params.fix_hint: Rename the property. Send `session_id` at the top level when you have a session id.

params.name: properties.screen_name
params.description: Heap documents `screen_name` as reserved because it conflicts with autocaptured Screen Name on mobile.

rules.message: The track call has neither `identity` nor `user_id`. Heap documents one of them as required.
rules.fix_hint: Send `identity` for a known user, or `user_id` for an anonymous Heap id.

rules.message: The track call sends both `identity` and `user_id`. Heap documents those as mutually exclusive.
